data.title: KSrelief Continues to Supply Safe Drinking Water to Displaced Persons in Aden
data.content:
Aden, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) continued supplying safe drinking water in Aden Governorate, Yemen, as part of an emergency response project to provide water to displaced persons.
    The center delivered safe drinking water through 21 distribution points in Al-Buraiqa District on Thursday, benefiting 398 families.
    These humanitarian and relief projects, implemented by Saudi Arabia through KSrelief, aim to improve living conditions, provide safe drinking water, strengthen community resilience, and pave the way for recovery in Yemen.
    -- SPA
21:27 Local Time 18:27 GMT
